verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly publish versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a keyless JSON data endpoint served by the Socrata open-data host platform (data.colorado.gov), which is a host-platform capability and earns no credit. Nothing in the pack documents API versioning or any deprecation policy from the Colorado Secretary of State.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
